author: Jonathan
html: Hi! I really like your blog, it is a great resource for myself and others to learn from! I wanted to ask about £ and how it relates to your trip. Did you save a lot of money before you left? Are you working along the way? If you could explain your financial situation in a broader sense it would really help me with my own questions. Thank you!

author: Basile
html: Hi Jonathan. I will definetly write a more detailed post about the financials of this trip ! In short : I worked in a startup before and saved up a few thousand dollars by living without without paying rent, by spending the nights couchsurfing only. Making small works here and there. Using past savings, i saved a total of around $9000. I bought the equipement for $3000 and try to spend as little as I can during the trip. If I run short, I’ll take a credit on my dad.
